that resets at Campfire nodes—forcing a trade-off between medals and warmth.

placeholder—make sure the HTML report shows it with before/after columns.

CHAT VS. HEAVY ENGINE SPLIT (WHY NOT RAW CODEX)
2 Codex sessions code in background; you plan Ch.2 live
In raw Codex chat, saying “start coding” freezes your window for minutes.
Summon separates ② Main Conversation from ③ Execution Sessions:
Session #1 · Route & Diff CLI
Codex · gpt-6.2-astra (max)
$ node diff.mjs → exit 0
Session #2 · Offline HTML
Codex · gpt-6.2-sol (xhigh)
$ node render.mjs → bundling
Code gate blocks ③ engines from spamming the room (403 room_send_forbidden)
① DIRECT FORWARD (STEER) & TOOL SELF-REPAIR
Mid-flight chat steers live Codex; tools self-heal
• Zero-latency direct forward (route: forward): At 10:05 you remember the
0-byte blank.png and 2-column layout. Lead Bot's ① Fast-Read matches
in-flight Session #2, bypasses ② Main Chat, and injects your words
straight into the running Codex thread via native steer!
• Out-of-band CLI self-healing: When a CLI update breaks parsing, tasks
send send(to: connection) to its Maintainer Bot to patch the script.
Built-in Bot Maintenance Room reviews daily connection_usage standups
STAGED DELIVERY, 90%+ CACHE & 5-LAYER PERSONA
Deliver as ready, iterate fast & persist room rules
• Staged verified delivery: At 10:06 the CLI finishes first (report.json);
at 10:07 the HTML report finishes with your steered edits and quotes 10:03.
• Stable Trunk + Private Fork (90%+ cache hit): Mid-turn tools & steers
run as A→B→C, collapsing to public A→C→D on the next turn.
• 5-Layer Persona & Material Index: At 10:10 your report format rule is
saved to material_index_ref (applies_to: room), surviving compression.
Hard Guardrails > Turn > Room > Individual > 17 Built-in Roles
